description: This file defines interfaces and types related to authorization attributes and decision-making within the Kubernetes API server, including Attributes interface, Authorizer interface, and related implementations.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: Interface for obtaining request attributes used in authorization decisions.

classes.name: Authorizer
classes.description: Interface for making authorization decisions based on Attributes.

classes.name: AuthorizerFunc
classes.description: Function type implementing the Authorizer interface.

classes.name: RuleResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving applicable rules for a user within a namespace.

classes.name: RequestAttributesGetter
classes.description: Interface for extracting Attributes from an HTTP request.

classes.name: AttributesRecord
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Attributes interface, holding request details.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Method to determine if an action is authorized based on Attributes.

methods.name: GetRequestAttributes
methods.description: Method to extract Attributes from an HTTP request.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Returns the user.Info object associated with the request.

methods.name: GetVerb
methods.description: Returns the verb associated with the request.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Indicates if the request is read-only.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the resource.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource.

methods.name: GetAPIGroup
methods.description: Returns the API group of the resource.

methods.name: IsResourceRequest
methods.description: Indicates if the request is for a resource.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the Decision value.
